claim_assertions.claim_1: Q4FY2025 GAAP and adjusted net income both grew relative to Q4FY2024.
claim_assertions.claim_2: Litigation accounts for more than half the FY2025 adjusted-minus-GAAP net-income gap.
claim_assertions.claim_3: FY2025 client incentives were approximately 28.25 percent of revenue before client incentives.

definitions.gross_to_net: FY2025, Q4FY2025 and 9MFY2025. Gross sums four positive revenue categories, incentives keep their negative source sign. First nine months is annual less Q4. Net revenue is gross revenue plus signed incentives. incentive_share_of_gross_pct is the positive deduction magnitude: -100 times signed incentives divided by gross revenue. residual_usd_million is reconstructed net revenue less independently reported net revenue.
definitions.net_income_reconciliation: Use the net-income column of each reconciliation, already after tax. Adjusted income is reconstructed as GAAP income plus the signed after-tax adjustment rows. Residual is that reconstructed amount less independently reported adjusted income. Missing categories are not separately observed adjustments. litigation_adjustment_usd_million is the sum of the signed litigation rows in that period. An empty set contributes zero to this additive bridge, without asserting a separately observed zero adjustment.
definitions.income_growth_bridge: Windows FY and Q4FY compare FY2025 with FY2024. Use independently reported GAAP and adjusted income for both periods, rather than the reconstructed adjusted amount in net_income_reconciliation. Gap change is current reported adjusted-minus-GAAP gap less prior reported gap.

evidence_policy: Cite sufficient supporting source IDs for each output. IDs may appear alone or inside explanations, with multiple IDs in one entry. Explanation-only entries do not supply evidence. Every cited ID must be relevant and known. Additional unrelated sections fail. Prose is not an entailment check and cannot repair incorrect numbers.
reconciliation_policy: Residuals compare independently supplied observations. Synthetic controls may make reported totals and components disagree. Preserve the discrepancy instead of forcing zero or changing a source observation. Algebraic identity residuals are not requested.
claim_policy: Supported means the supplied evidence entails the assertion. Contradicted means it entails the negation. Unresolved means neither follows. A claim that the supplied dossier explicitly reports a quantity is contradicted when the supplied scope explicitly omits it. A claim about the unknown economic quantity itself remains unresolved. Do not infer zero from missing information. No label count or order is promised.
text_policy: Text columns declare canonical values and accepted source-label aliases. Aliases refer to the same economic category, never a different period, unit or measure. Duplicate keys after normalization fail. Different SQL, row order and column order are accepted. Numeric tolerances are unchanged.
